1. I have come from Jalandhar. The underlined part tells us that the action of ‘coming from Jalandhar’ took place sometime in the recent past.

2. Rita has read all the poems written by Sarojini Naidu. The underlined part tells us about an ‘experience of reading’, that took place in the past but is still relevant in the present. The above sentences have used present perfect tense. We use present perfect tense to talk about: • Actions that were completed in the recent past. • Actions or experiences that happened in the past but affect the present. Now complete the following sentences using present perfect tense. a. I ...................... (visit) Delhi many times. It is a city with many historical sites. Rule Subject + has/have + Verb + Object Reprint 2026-27
